anchor_comparisons: The counter anchor's 10.32-12.72 band is the closer discipline because current earnings remain price-sensitive and exposed to one-time and ramp costs, but actual 2026-Q1 memory profit strength supports a value above its midpoint.
The positive anchor's 13.68-16.08 band assumes stronger persistence than can be established while HBM-specific profit and company-level FCF are forecasts and latest EPS revision direction is DOWN.
disagreements: The memo midpoint gives too much weight to forecast HBM unit economics before issuer-reported HBM cash conversion exists.
Memory-wide actuals cannot by themselves establish that HBM is the durable source of company FCF expansion.
payload.rationale: All five counterfacts show that the apparent explosion is cyclical and attribution-sensitive: one-time charges and ramp costs have reduced memory profit, the current bridge relies heavily on pricing, and HBM sales and pricing have previously fallen together. Most positive actuals are memory-wide, while HBM profit, gross margin and company FCF are estimates. This supports positive but materially discounted component points.
payload.why_not_higher: The evidence lacks HBM-only actual revenue, operating cash flow and FCF, while price normalization, DOWN revision direction and execution costs can reverse operating leverage.
payload.why_not_lower: The countercase does not erase the current memory revenue surge, large operating-profit contribution and observed HBM/high-density DDR5 mix-to-ASP mechanism.
